appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.darkModeDescription: Use the dark theme across the app.

folders.title: Data folders
folders.description: Where Story Forge keeps profiles and game versions. Defaults to the app data directory.
folders.useAppDirectoryDescription: Store profiles and versions inside Story Forge's own folder.
folders.hintAppDirectory: Using the app data directory. A "{{subdir}}" folder is created inside it.
folders.hintDefault: Defaults to the app data directory.
folders.hintInside: A "{{subdir}}" folder is created inside this directory.

dialog.title: How do you want to handle existing data?
dialog.description: Data currently lives in the folder you are leaving. This cannot be undone once deleted.
dialog.keep: Keep current data (do not move or delete)
dialog.copy: Copy current data to new location
dialog.delete: Delete current data from old location

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.streamModeDescription: Hide server addresses in server lists, for example while streaming.
behaviour.systemDotnetDescription: Try your system's .NET runtime before downloading one.
behaviour.defaultModSortDescription: Sort order used when the mod browser opens.

gameDefaults.title: Game defaults
gameDefaults.description: One set of key bindings, game and video settings shared by every profile.
gameDefaults.applyDescription: Merge the defaults into a profile's settings right before the game starts. Profiles can opt out in their own settings.
gameDefaults.sheetDescription: Saves the key bindings, game and video settings of the chosen profile as the defaults applied on launch. Mod paths, disabled mods, server lists and entitlements are never copied.
gameDefaults.includeSessionHint: Also copies the signed-in player's name, user id, email and session tokens so the profile stays logged in. A launcher account selected for the launch still takes precedence.

updates.title: Updates
updates.label: Updates
updates.description: Checks quietly; updates are announced in the title bar.

logs.title: Application log
logs.description: Live app output, refreshed every 5 seconds.
